feat(ai-integration): cap parallel jobs per AI integration

Let operators bound how many jobs run at once against a single AI integration, so self-hosted or resource-constrained providers (a local vLLM / llama.cpp backend) are not flooded by concurrent review jobs.

commits.author: Tom Seidel
commits.message:
feat(usage): show the agent-loop round of every AI interaction

The Usage page audits every AI call but cannot say how deep into an agent loop a call happened: ten rounds of one coding run and ten unrelated one-shot calls look identical in the table, so the per-round token cost and the loop depth cannot be read off it. The round is already known inside the loops — AgentLoop's counter (coding, writer, triage, agentic review) and the four PR-workflow agent runners (E2E, unit-test, README-sync, i18n coverage) — it just never reached the audit record.

commits.author: Tom Seidel
commits.message:
feat(agent): add execute validation tool for repository-provided scripts
Repositories whose success is not decided by a language toolchain (documentation-only, CI/CD, infrastructure) had nothing to validate with:the coding agent resolves validation from a fixed list of build/testcommands. execute hands that decision to the repository by naming a script committed inside it.
